sources.title: Portable Network Graphics Specification, Third Edition
sources.release_version_or_commit: W3C Recommendation, 2025-06-24
sources.observed_operation: Defines precedence for understood color chunks as cICP, iCCP, sRGB, then cHRM plus gAMA; states untagged RGB is uncalibrated device-dependent color; alpha is full-range opacity and is not gamma-corrected; lists text, time, Exif, and animation chunks.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Color precedence applies to supported signals understood by a decoder. The spec says standalone viewers may choose a likely default for unknown gamma and allow the user to adjust it.
sources.applicability: PNG color interpretation, output signal, alpha handling, privacy chunk allowlist, and proposed conflict fixtures.

sources.title: WebP Container Specification
sources.release_version_or_commit: Current Google for Developers specification; no numbered release shown
sources.locator: RIFF structure; color-profile chunk; metadata, unknown chunks, animation, and file termination
sources.observed_operation: WebP can carry ICCP, EXIF, XMP, alpha, animation, and unknown chunks; ICCP must precede image data and sRGB should be assumed when ICCP is absent; readers may ignore extra metadata chunks.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Rules apply to the extended RIFF container and its feature flags; simple and extended WebP files have different feature envelopes.
sources.applicability: Format-specific fallback, animation policy, fresh output construction, and byte-level metadata audit.

sources.title: ICC.1 v4 Specification index
sources.release_version_or_commit: ICC.1:2022, profile version 4.4.0.0; published May 2022
sources.locator: ICC.1 v4 overview and version table, including CICP and metadata tags
sources.observed_operation: The ICC page identifies v4.4 and lists CICP and metadata-related changes.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The index identifies the specification but does not select a product CMM, profile fallback, rendering intent, or supported transform.
sources.applicability: Pin the profile standard used; record source/target profiles, CMM, intent, and compatibility checks.

sources.title: libvips vips_thumbnail API documentation
sources.release_version_or_commit: API documentation version 8.17; not the current 8.18.7 release
sources.locator: vips_thumbnail description and arguments: orientation, size, crop, linear, profiles, intent, fail_on
sources.observed_operation: thumbnail combines loading and resize; it interprets orientation tags by default, can resize with crop/size controls, normally shrinks in sRGB, offers a linear option, supports input/output profiles and intent, defaults fail_on to permissive, and uses the first frame/page by default.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Behavior depends on loader and format. Linear mode can be slower because JPEG shrink-on-load cannot be used. API docs are for 8.17; exact version/API path needs regression coverage.
sources.applicability: Shows a backend can combine shrink-on-load and orientation behavior; supports comparing optimized and reference paths rather than enforcing full-resolution rotate-first.

sources.title: libvips programmer checklist
sources.release_version_or_commit: Rolling current documentation; page has no version number
sources.locator: Thumbnail versus resize, alpha premultiplication, progressive/interlaced images, sequential access
sources.observed_operation: Recommends thumbnail for format-specific shrink-on-load and lower memory; says thumbnail automatically premultiplies; gives an example where progressive JPEG requires full-image memory and defeats streaming.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Measurements are examples and depend on format, interlace state, loader and build.
sources.applicability: Compare optimization and resource behavior; isolate or separately limit progressive JPEG.

sources.title: libvips release v8.18.7
sources.release_version_or_commit: v8.18.7, commit 24ad4d0; released 2026-09-26
sources.locator: Release entry; changes since 8.18.6
sources.observed_operation: GitHub marks v8.18.7 as latest tagged release at review time; release predates the Oct 2 merge of PR #5235.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Release notes are not a complete behavioral proof, and downstream packages may differ.
sources.applicability: Version boundary for the historical fail_on report; verify the exact package/build selected by the owner.

sources.title: libvips issue 1523: autorot and thumbnail_image interaction
sources.release_version_or_commit: Reported 2020-01-12 against libvips 8.9.0; issue closed after fix 34fcd1f; maintainer says safe in 8.9.1
sources.locator: Issue description, maintainer comments on thumbnail rotation and close/fix history
sources.observed_operation: Reporter observed orientation differences between 8.8.4 and 8.9.0 when autorot and thumbnail_image were combined. Maintainer states thumbnail can autorotate at the end and reports the API combination fixed in 8.9.1.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Historical defect; current behavior is API/version-specific and the issue does not prove current backends share the same ordering.
sources.applicability: Supports one logical orientation owner and tests for transform combinations; contradicts a universal requirement to rotate the full image before shrink.

sources.title: libvips issue 5195: fail_on ignored by thumbnail_buffer and thumbnail_source — status recheck
sources.release_version_or_commit: Reported 2026-08-25 on libvips 8.18.5; closed as completed on 2026-10-02 by PR #5235; patch commit 6b5dcce
sources.locator: Issue reproduction/actual-result table, environment, and activity/status
sources.observed_operation: The reported truncated JPEG was refused by file thumbnail with fail_on=error but accepted by thumbnail_buffer and thumbnail_source with the same argument; loader option_string=fail_on=error refused it. Issue now links a completed fix.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Reproduction was on 8.18.5 and issue history says behavior was in master before the fix; current tagged release/package inclusion is not established by the issue page alone.
sources.applicability: Keep an API/build-specific truncation regression. Do not describe the report as open or assume every post-issue build remains affected.

sources.title: libvips PR #5235: thumbnail passes missing fail_on argument to loaders
sources.release_version_or_commit: Merged into libvips master on 2026-10-02; commit 6b5dcce
sources.locator: PR merge status and merge commit
sources.observed_operation: PR is marked merged and resolves issue #5195 by forwarding fail_on to the buffer/source loaders.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: PR merge into master is not evidence that a particular released binary or downstream package contains the fix.
sources.applicability: Corrects issue status and narrows regression advice to pinned release/API coverage.

sources.title: Pillow ImageOps documentation
sources.release_version_or_commit: Pillow 12.3.0 stable documentation
sources.locator: exif_transpose; contain, cover, fit, pad and resize methods
sources.observed_operation: exif_transpose applies a non-identity EXIF Orientation and removes the orientation data; contain/cover/fit have different geometry behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: ImageOps behavior and defaults are API-specific; exif_transpose has an explicit in_place option.
sources.applicability: Candidate explicit transform route and reference for output geometry tests.

sources.title: Pillow ImageCms documentation
sources.release_version_or_commit: Pillow 12.3.0 stable documentation; LittleCMS integration
sources.locator: profileToProfile/buildTransform methods, supported mode/intent, default intent
sources.observed_operation: ImageCms applies ICC transforms; the default intent constant is perceptual; invalid profiles or incompatible modes/intents can raise PyCMSError.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Supported transform direction and intent depend on source/target profiles and modes; defaults are not product choices.
sources.applicability: Candidate CMM interface; pin version and record explicit profile/intent policy.

sources.title: Pillow security handbook
sources.release_version_or_commit: Pillow 12.3.0 stable documentation
sources.locator: D-1 decompression bomb; D-2 CPU exhaustion; mitigation recommendations
sources.observed_operation: Documents pixel threshold warning/error behavior, large-legal-image CPU cost, and mitigations including format allowlists, treating warnings as errors, practical dimension/CPU limits, and OS/container memory caps.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Threshold values are configurable and installed defaults can vary; inspect the selected build.
sources.applicability: Resource policy for untrusted contributor images.

sources.title: Pillow issue 8554 and PR 8556 orientation history
sources.release_version_or_commit: Issue reported 2024-11-15 using Pillow 11.0.0; PR #8556 closed as completed 2025-03-29; exact first released version not captured here
sources.locator: CR2/TIFF reproducer, maintainer explanation of removing orientation after auto-transpose, linked PR #8556
sources.observed_operation: An orientation-tagged CR2/TIFF path exposed disagreement between pixels and the visible EXIF tag; maintainers describe clearing the tag to prevent a second transpose; the report was fixed.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Historical format/decoder path, not prevalence evidence or proof every TIFF/RAW path behaves the same.
sources.applicability: Include TIFF/CR2-like orientation fixtures and check both rendered pixels and serialized metadata.

sources.title: ImageMagick command-line options
sources.release_version_or_commit: Rolling official documentation; no release version shown
sources.locator: -limit, -profile, -filter and -resize sections
sources.observed_operation: Exposes width, height, area, memory, map, disk, file, thread, throttle and time limits; pixel cache may spill from memory/map to disk; profile is an ordered operator and resize filter settings affect output.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Installed limits adjust with available resources; memory pressure alone may move work to disk rather than reject it.
sources.applicability: Alternative resource and color-operation approach; set disk and dimension limits as well as memory.

sources.title: ImageMagick security policy
sources.release_version_or_commit: Rolling official documentation; no release version shown
sources.locator: Policy model, coder/path and resource controls
sources.observed_operation: The security policy is configuration-specific; generally last matching policy wins, with canonical-path denials additionally enforced.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Policy ordering may override earlier rules; runtime options do not establish the actual installed policy.
sources.applicability: Pin and review configuration if ImageMagick is selected.

sources.title: Rust image crate decoder limits
sources.release_version_or_commit: image crate 0.25.10
sources.locator: Limits description and max_image_width, max_image_height, max_alloc fields
sources.observed_operation: Width and height caps are strict; max_alloc is non-strict by default and some decoders may ignore it; default max_alloc is 512 MiB.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: A decoder must fail if it cannot guarantee an explicitly strict limit; support is decoder-specific.
sources.applicability: Rust-native option requires a per-decoder limit audit and an external process memory boundary.

sources.title: Rust image crate orientation API
sources.release_version_or_commit: image crate 0.25.10
sources.locator: Orientation variants and remove_from_exif_chunk
sources.observed_operation: Represents the eight EXIF-compatible transforms; removing the orientation from the EXIF chunk sets NoTransforms and avoids a second transform by a later viewer.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Invalid EXIF returns None and leaves the chunk unchanged.
sources.applicability: Candidate orientation handling; invalid and mirrored cases still need decoder-specific tests.

sources.title: Rust image crate ImageDecoder metadata interface
sources.release_version_or_commit: image crate 0.25.10
sources.locator: Provided methods exif_metadata, icc_profile, iptc_metadata, xmp_metadata, orientation, and set_limits
sources.observed_operation: The decoder trait exposes optional metadata and orientation methods; their base implementations return absent/default values and concrete decoder implementations determine actual format coverage.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: A uniform trait does not guarantee that every format decoder implements every metadata method.
sources.applicability: Audit metadata and orientation support by concrete decoder and accepted format.

sources.title: AV1 Image File Format specification
sources.release_version_or_commit: AVIF v1.2.0
sources.locator: Sections 2.2 image item properties, 4.1 auxiliary images, 4.2.2 tone-map derived image, item references
sources.observed_operation: AVIF can use auxiliary alpha/depth items and derived tone-map/gain-map items; the gain-map image should be hidden; properties and item relations affect the interpreted image.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: AVIF is an ISO-BMFF item graph, not one raster plus flat tags; item support and interpretation depend on the parser and applicable HEIF/MIAF properties.
sources.applicability: If admitted, define primary/auxiliary/derived item handling and audit the output graph.

sources.title: CIPA standards index: Exif 3.1
sources.release_version_or_commit: CIPA DC-008-Translation-2026, Exif 3.1; published 2026-01-30
sources.locator: Digital cameras, DC-008-Translation-2026 entry and revision note
sources.observed_operation: Official index identifies the current Exif version and links the standard.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The index establishes version authority but not behavior of any decoder or exporter.
sources.applicability: Pin Exif serialization/tag semantics for implementation and privacy audit.

sources.title: CIPA standards index: Multi-Picture Format
sources.release_version_or_commit: Index announces CIPA DC-007-Translation-2026 on 2026-08-19; detail card reports publication 2025-01-24 and history through 2025
sources.locator: Standards page announcement and DC-007 detail card
sources.observed_operation: The index links a 2026 translation but the detail card retains 2025 publication/history text; the full linked 2026 standard was not opened.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Index metadata alone cannot establish exact current clauses or decoder/writer behavior.
sources.applicability: Preserve uncertainty; pin and inspect the actual standard before MPF/MPO support.

sources.title: ExifTool FAQ: duplicates and metadata deletion
sources.release_version_or_commit: FAQ last revised 2026-01-04; ExifTool 13.58 documentation observed
sources.locator: FAQ sections on duplicate tags/GPS, FAQ 32 metadata deletion, color-space information
sources.observed_operation: The FAQ says duplicate tags can be suppressed unless requested, GPS may be stored outside EXIF, RAW may require metadata for display, and deleting metadata may remove color-space information; it gives a JPEG example preserving ICC/color tags.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Metadata and color-preservation operations differ by file type; JPEG is comparatively suited to separation, while RAW may need metadata.
sources.applicability: Support bounded privacy claims, duplicate/namespace auditing, and preservation of output color interpretation.
